  • Live Game Shows: Interactive wheel and board game formats including Crazy Time, Monopoly Live, Sweet Bonanza Candyland, and Lightning Roulette.

How to Register in GalleonBet

Setting up an account at Galleonbet Casino is a simple process designed to adhere strictly to regulatory standards and anti-money laundering (AML) laws. 

Account Registration Steps

All you need to do is follow these 5 easy steps:

  1. Visit the Platform: Open the official site in your browser or launch the Progressive Web App.

  2. Fill in Details: Click the "Sign Up" button and enter your full legal name, date of birth, residential address, email address, and preferred account currency (e.g., GBP £).

  3. Set Security Credentials: Create a strong password and choose your preferred contact preferences.

  4. Set Responsible Gambling Limits: During registration, players can set daily, weekly, or monthly deposit limits right away.

  5. Confirm Email: Click the confirmation link sent to your registered email inbox to activate the account.

Verification (KYC) Requirements

Before processing your first cash withdrawal, our safety protocols require account verification under Know Your Customer (KYC) rules. Verification involves submitting clear copies or photos of three main document types.

First, to verify your identity, you must provide a valid passport, full UK driving licence, or national ID card. 

Second, for proof of address, we accept a utility bill (such as gas, water, or electricity) or a bank statement, provided the document is dated within the last 3 months. 

Finally, to confirm your payment method, you will need to submit a photo of your debit card—showing only the first 6 and last 4 digits—or a screenshot of your e-wallet account details.

Documents can be uploaded directly through your account dashboard under the "Verification" tab. Processing typically takes between 12 to 24 hours.

Galleon Casino License and Security

At Galleon, user safety and data integrity are central to our platform operations:

  • Data Encryption: All sensitive data exchanged between your device and our servers is secured using SSL/TLS encryption.

  • Fair Gaming & RNG: All non-live casino games rely on RNGs, ensuring that outcomes are entirely random and unmanipulated.
